subject: Speech
source_sentence: We report and discuss the results of five classification tasks: (1) the directness of the speech , (2) the hostility type of the tweet, (3) the discriminating target attribute, (4) the target group , and (5) the annotator's sentiment.
title: Multilingual and Multi-Aspect Hate Speech Analysis
